questions.q: The least value of the expression \(2\log_{10}x-\log_x(0.01)\) for \(x>1\) is
questions.sol: \(\log_x(0.01)=-2\log_x10\), so the expression is \(2\left(\log_{10}x+\dfrac1{\log_{10}x}\right)\ge4\) for \(x>1\). The least value is \(4\).

questions.q: Let \((x_0,y_0)\) be the solution of the following equations \((2x)^{\ln2}=(3y)^{\ln3}\), \(3^{\ln x}=2^{\ln y}\). Then \(x_0\) is
questions.sol: Taking logarithms: \(\ln2(\ln2+\ln x)=\ln3(\ln3+\ln y)\) and \(\ln y=\dfrac{\ln3}{\ln2}\ln x\). Substituting: \(\ln x\cdot\dfrac{\ln^22-\ln^23}{\ln2}=\ln^23-\ln^22\), so \(\ln x=-\ln2\).
\(x\ln3=2(x-1)\ln2\) gives \(x=\dfrac{2\ln2}{2\ln2-\ln3}\). Dividing numerator and denominator by \(\ln3\), \(\ln2\) and \(2\ln2\) gives (a), (b), (c).

questions.q: If \(\exp\{(\sin^2x+\sin^4x+\sin^6x+\ldots\infty)\ln2\}\) satisfies the equation \(x^2-9x+8=0\), find the value of \(\dfrac{\cos x}{\cos x+\sin x}\), \(0<x<\dfrac\pi2\).
questions.sol: The series is \(\tan^2x\), so the number is \(2^{\tan^2x}=1\) or \(8\); for \(0<x<\frac\pi2\): \(\tan^2x=3\), \(\tan x=\sqrt3\). \(\dfrac1{1+\tan x}=\dfrac1{1+\sqrt3}\).

questions.q: The product of all positive real values of \(x\) satisfying the equation \(x^{\left(16(\log_5x)^3-68\log_5x\right)}=5^{-16}\) is _____.
questions.sol: With \(t=\log_5x\): \(16t^4-68t^2+16=0\), \(t^2=4\) or \(\frac14\), \(t=\pm2,\pm\frac12\). The values of \(t\) add to \(0\), so the product of the \(x\)'s is \(5^0=1\).
